intro: Jobs similar to theatrical makeup artists are design and visual arts roles. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Floral Designers (73% similar), Art Directors (72%) and Fashion Designers (72%). Most of them pay less than makeup work.
shared: These careers share an eye for color and detail, working to a director's or client's vision and finishing on tight deadlines. O*NET rates judgment at 3.25 out of 5 for makeup artists and coordination at 3.12. Fashion, interior and display design use the same visual skills. Makeup artists already earn a strong $97,150 median, so only 3 of the 20 pay more.

faq.q: Which jobs like makeup artist pay more?
faq.a: 3 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Advertising and Promotions Managers earn $133,660 (38% more), Art Directors $114,850 (18% more) and special effects artists and animators $102,030 (5% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. All three usually need a bachelor's degree.

faq.q: What jobs like makeup artist need less training?
faq.a: 3 of the 20 similar careers usually need less preparation: Floral Designers, Costume Attendants and Models. They pay less than makeup work; Floral Designers earn $37,360, which is 62% less than the theatrical makeup artist median, according to BLS May 2025 data.
